title: The Divine King Revives
summary: Fairy Caiyun, who waited 4,000 years for Jiang Taixu, borrows Ye Fan's whip and puts the three Old Demons back in their graves. The Dark Night King (Immortal Platform 3rd Heaven), one of Zhongzhou's Twin Kings, whose brother Jiang Taixu killed long ago, then attacks to destroy the Jiang clan. Ye Fan burns the Mystic Fire of his divine furnace to resonate with the Hengyu Divine Furnace and restart part of the Great Emperor formation. With thirty minutes left, Caiyun burns her own life force to power the dragon pearl, asking that her aged face be covered with a white cloth, and dies. Jiang Taixu wakes and traps the Dark Night King in his Divine King Holy Land, and although the king wears a Sage's battle robe made to counter it, Taixu kills him. Grieving, Taixu lifts the cloth, vows to win back Caiyun's young face from heaven, and remembers his promise to watch the sunset with her.
